room_rent.note: Policy covers hospital room rent under in-patient treatment with no stated room rent sub-limit or cap in the policy wording or schedule of benefits.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient treatment with no stated cap or sub-limit.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment. Co-payment is an optional benefit that can be opted at 10% or 20%; once opted it cannot be removed. No geography-based co-pay applies.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise monetary sub-limits found in the policy wording or schedule of benefits.

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of ₹25K/₹50K/₹1L can be opted; once opted cannot be reduced.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) have a 24-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity is excluded from base plan. Available via 'Parenthood' add-on covering maternity expenses, embryo storage and IVF after 2-year waiting period.

cumulative_bonus.note: Multiplier Benefit: 50% of base SI added each claim-free or claim year at renewal, capped at 100% of base SI. Applies irrespective of claims.

restoration.note: Inbuilt Restore Benefit restores 100% of base SI once per policy year on complete or partial utilisation. Unlimited Restore (optional add-on) triggers unlimited times.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day care procedures under general or local anaesthesia requiring less than 24-hour stay are covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary treatment covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available; minimum 3-day treatment required.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered in recognised AYUSH hospitals. OPD AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Medical and surgical expenses of organ donor for harvesting covered when insured is recipient. Donor's pre/post-hospitalisation and insured donating an organ excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Air ambulance covered up to ₹2.5L per hospitalisation (within India only).

modern_treatments.note: No specific exclusion or sub-limit for modern/robotic treatments found; covered under in-patient treatment up to sum insured.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables (List I items) excluded from base plan. 'Protector Rider' add-on covers IRDAI-listed excluded items including consumables.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. 'Critical Advantage Rider' add-on covers planned treatment abroad for 8 listed major illnesses.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, sleep apnoea, external congenital anomalies, maternity (base), consumables (List I), circumcision, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Unlimited Restore, Parenthood (maternity/IVF), Protector (consumables), Critical Advantage (overseas), Personal Accident, ABCD Chronic Care, Hospital Daily Cash
